name: Dice game
summary:
You are asked to participate in a game of dice. The croupier will roll a regular dice two times and if the product of the resulting pips is at least 19, you get a pay-off of 36€. The stake for the game is 9€.

When the croupier sees your hesitance to play, you are offered to see the result of the first roll for 4€, before paying additional 6€ to continue to the second dice roll.

What will you do to maximize your result?

levels.name: Framing
levels.description:
To help the decision-making process we should be clear on the framing;

What can be considered as 'given', and is out of scope for the decision at hand?
What is to be decided 'later' and not important for now?
What is actually a decision to take now and is 'in scope'?
